info.title: SmartBill API
info.description:
## Introduction SmartBill API is a REST API for integrating the SmartBill Cloud platform with any external system: online store, ERP or CRM. Endpoints are organized by resource (invoices, estimates, etc.), accept JSON and return standard HTTP codes. ***Last updated: 17 August 2026*** **With the SmartBill API you can:** - issue, reverse, cancel and delete documents - issue payments and check payment status - query stock levels - send documents to clients by email - query company settings (VAT rates, document series) **API versions** Choose **V1** for invoicing and everyday operations. Choose **V3** for new features. | API | Purpose | Base URL | |-----|------|----------| | **V1** | Invoicing and everyday operations | `https://ws.smartbill.ro/SBORO/api` | | **V3** | New features | `https://ws.smartbill.ro/SBORO/api/v3` | ## AI-assisted integration ✨ You can give the API documentation directly to an AI assistant - Claude, ChatGPT - and have it generate integration code, explain fields or help you with errors. **Download the OpenAPI spec** Download the OpenAPI documentation in YAML or JSON format and attach it directly to any AI assistant. **Context prompt for AI** Copy the prompt below and add it before your question, together with the attached spec file. This gives the AI the context it needs. ```text Help me integrate the SmartBill API. I am attaching the full OpenAPI spec. Before you read it, here is critical context that is not visible from the schema: Choose the correct API: use V1 for invoicing and everyday operations. Use V3 for the new features documented in the spec. V1 uses Basic Auth with email + apiToken. V3 uses a Bearer token and includes the company CIF in the URL. V1 response: the errorText field is the source of truth for the error cause - if it is empty the call succeeded, if it is populated it contains the error message. The HTTP code is meaningful, but not exhaustive: always read errorText, not just the status. V3 errors: error responses use the format with errors[], code, message and docUrl. For integration logic, rely on the HTTP status and code, not only on the message text. V1 field-name typo: a field with an unknown name is not ignored. The request returns HTTP 400 with a JSON body shaped {"type": "invalid_request_error", "errors": [{"code": "json_mapping_error", "param": ""}]}, without errorText. Read errors[].param to find exactly which field is wrong. The same shape appears when a value has a type other than the expected one and when the JSON is syntactically invalid. Account-dependent strings: seriesName, taxName and measuringUnitName must match exactly the values configured in the user's SmartBill Cloud account. Do not invent these values; ask the user or read them from the available endpoints/settings. Price and VAT: product prices in V1 are by default WITHOUT VAT (isTaxIncluded: false). Set isTaxIncluded: true only if the price already includes VAT. V1 rate limiting: 30 calls per 10 seconds per token. When exceeded, access is blocked for 10 minutes. Watch X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining and X-RateLimit-Reset. V3 rate limiting: limits are separate for reads and writes and include a daily limit. Requests are accumulated by user + company, including when multiple tokens or applications are used. On 429, use Retry-After and the X-RateLimit-* / X-RateLimit-Daily-* headers for retry and throttling. Do not retry immediately. ``` **Where to start** - *Generate Python code that issues an invoice to a legal-entity client* - *Which fields are required when issuing an invoice?* - *How do I reverse an invoice issued by mistake?* - *Help me understand the error: Produsul Produs Test nu are codul specificat.* ## Quickstart Issue your first invoice in 3 simple steps. You need an active [SmartBill Cloud](https://cloud.smartbill.ro) account. > 💡 The SmartBill API has 2 versions: > > - **V1** - invoicing, payments, stock, settings > - **V3** - warehouses, products, clients, suppliers, goods-receipt notes > > The quickstart uses V1. For V3 see [Authentication V3](#api-1/description/authentication-v3). **Step 1. Create an invoice series** Document series are configured from the SmartBill interface. Go to the [Serii](https://cloud.smartbill.ro/core/configurare/serii/) page and create a new invoice series. Note the series name - you will use it in step 3. **Step 2. Get the V1 API token** The V1 API token is generated automatically when your SmartBill account is created. Go to the [Integrari](https://cloud.smartbill.ro/core/integrari/) page, to the **API** section, and copy the **Email**, **Token** and **CIF** values. You will use them in the next step. **Step 3. Issue the invoice** Replace `EMAIL`, `TOKEN`, `COMPANY_VAT_CODE` (your SmartBill account's CIF) and the invoice series with the value from step 1: ```bash curl -X POST https://ws.smartbill.ro/SBORO/api/invoice/v2 \ -u "EMAIL:TOKEN" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{ "companyVatCode": "COMPANY_VAT_CODE", "client": { "name": "Client Test SRL", "country": "Romania" }, "seriesName": "INVOICE_SERIES", "products": [{ "name": "Produs Test", "code": "TEST01", "quantity": 1, "price": 100, "measuringUnitName": "buc", "taxName": "Normala", "taxPercentage": 21 }] }' ``` Response: ```json { "errorText": "", "message": "", "number": "3593", "series": "INVOICE_SERIES", "url": "", "documentUrl": "https://cloud.smartbill.ro/documente/editare/factura/20363/", "documentId": 20363, "documentViewUrl": "https://cloud.smartbill.ro/documente/extern/pf/factura/f6a9a7d3...?srvid=2" } ``` If `errorText` is empty, the invoice was issued successfully. For all options (invoices from estimate, discounts, payment link, etc.) and response details, see [Invoices](#api-1/tag/invoices). ## Authentication V1 The V1 API uses standard HTTP **Basic Authentication**. You send the credentials in the `Authorization` header, as `email:token` encoded in base64. You can find the credentials on the [Integrari](https://cloud.smartbill.ro/core/integrari/) page, in the API section. **Example** ```bash curl -X POST https://ws.smartbill.ro/SBORO/api/invoice/v2 \ -u "EMAIL:TOKEN" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{ ... }' ``` ## Authentication V3 The V3 API uses **Bearer tokens**. You send the token in the `Authorization: Bearer ` header. The token is generated from the [Integrari](https://cloud.smartbill.ro/core/integrari/) page. V3 URLs include the company CIF: `.../v3/companies/{cif}/resource`. Replace `{cif}` with your CIF on every request. Each token belongs to one user and one company. **Example** ```bash curl -H "Authorization: Bearer " \ https://ws.smartbill.ro/SBORO/api/v3/companies/COMPANY_VAT_CODE/clients ``` ## Responses All responses are in **JSON** format, but the structure differs between V1 and V3. **V1** - on success you get HTTP 200 with an empty `errorText` and the fields of the issued document. Errors come with specific HTTP codes (400, 401 etc.) and a populated `errorText`. ```json { "errorText": "", "message": "", "number": "3593", "series": "INVOICE_SERIES", "url": "", "documentUrl": "https://cloud.smartbill.ro/documente/editare/factura/20363/", "documentId": 20363, "documentViewUrl": "https://cloud.smartbill.ro/documente/extern/pf/factura/f6a9a7d3...?srvid=2" } ``` | Field | Content | |------|----------| | `errorText` | Empty on success. If populated, contains the cause of the error. | | `message` | Auxiliary message, usually empty. | | `number` + `series` | The document identifier (e.g. `fac 3593`). | | `url` | Payment link, populated only if you sent `paymentUrl: "Generate URL"`. | | `documentUrl` | Edit link in SmartBill Cloud (requires authentication). | | `documentId` | Document ID in SmartBill Cloud. Included in `documentUrl`. `-1` on error. | | `documentViewUrl` | Public link to the PDF - you send it to the end client without requiring authentication. | **V3** - the response structure depends on the type of query: | Query type | Response structure | No results | Example | |---|---|---|---| | List (`/warehouses`) | `items[]` + `pagination` object | `items: []`, `pagination.next/previous: null` - you do not get a 404 | `{ "items": [...], "pagination": { "next": "...", "previous": null } }` | | By ID (`/warehouses/{id}`) | direct object, no `items` | 404 | `{ "id": "...", "name": "..." }` | **V3 ids** are stable over time: you can store them on your side and use them later to fetch the record via `GET .../{id}` or as an `after` / `before` pagination cursor. The prefix tells you the record type: | Prefix | Resource | |---|---| | `cus_` | clients | | `sup_` | suppliers | | `ware_` | warehouses | | `prod_` | products and services | An id used on a resource other than the one its prefix names returns `400` with `malformed_id`. ## General format rules - **Encoding**: the request body is sent in **UTF-8**. - **Booleans**: boolean fields also accept `1` / `0`, not only `true` / `false`. - **Percentages**: percentage values are sent as numbers, without the `%` symbol. `taxPercentage: 21` works; `taxPercentage: "21%"` returns `400`. - **Special characters in JSON**: quotes and backslashes inside text must be escaped (`\"` and `\\`), otherwise the request body is not valid JSON and you get `400`. ## Pagination Pagination applies only to the **V3 API**. The V1 API does not support pagination. V3 listing endpoints accept the following query params: | Parameter | Type | Min | Max | Default | Description | |-----------|-----|-----|-----|---------|-------------| | `limit` | number | 1 | 100 | 20 | Maximum number of results | | `after` | string | - | - | - | Cursor: the id to continue after (mutually exclusive with `before`) | | `before` | string | - | - | - | Cursor: the id to continue before (mutually exclusive with `after`) | **Paginated list example** ```bash curl -X GET "https://ws.smartbill.ro/SBORO/api/v3/companies/COMPANY_VAT_CODE/warehouses?limit=5&after=ware_019f17cddf1272d59f06892d5b760d0b" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer " ``` **Following the cursor** `pagination.next` and `pagination.previous` are full URLs and they preserve the filters of the original request. Call them as they are - you do not need to re-append `name`, `code` or `vatCode`. When there is no further page in that direction, the field is `null`. That holds even when the last page filled up exactly to `limit`, so `next: null` is a reliable end signal - you do not need one extra request to confirm. **Pagination errors** | Situation | `code` | HTTP | |----------|--------|------| | `limit` out of range (0 or 101) | `invalid_field_value` | 400 | | `limit` is not a number | `invalid_field_type` | 400 | | `before` and `after` used together | `invalid_field_value` | 400 | | cursor with wrong prefix | `malformed_id` | 400 | | cursor with invalid format | `malformed_id` | 400 | ## Errors The SmartBill API uses standard HTTP codes. The error body format differs between V1 and V3. ### API V1 Errors The V1 error response carries the message in the `errorText` field. | HTTP code | Explanation | When it occurs | |----------|------------|------------| | 400 | Invalid request | Malformed JSON, unknown field name, value of the wrong type, or failed business validation | | 401 | Unauthenticated | Wrong credentials or token | | 403 | Forbidden | Token without permissions on the resource | | 404 | Not found | No resource with the given ID/CIF/series exists | | 405 | Method not allowed | The HTTP verb is not accepted on the endpoint, for example `GET` on `/invoice/v2`. The response includes an `Allow` header listing the accepted verbs | | 415 | Unsupported media type | `Content-Type` is missing or has a value other than `application/json` | | 422 | Invalid data (business validation) | Read `errorText` for the cause | | 429 | Rate limit exceeded | Too many calls. Watch the rate limit headers | | 500 | Server error | Retry with backoff | **Error responses come in two shapes.** Not all of them have `errorText`: - **Business validation** - the classic V1 shape, with `errorText` populated: nonexistent series, empty product list, nonexistent VAT rate, missing permissions. The typical codes are `400`, `401` and `422`. - **Invalid request** - the request is rejected before the invoicing logic and the response has **no `errorText`**. The body has a different shape: ```json { "status": 400, "type": "invalid_request_error", "instance": "/SBORO/api/invoice/v2", "errors": [ { "code": "json_mapping_error", "message": "Unrecognized property: zzz.", "docUrl": "https://api.smartbill.ro/#v3-error-invalid_request_error", "param": "zzz" } ] } ``` The values of `code`: | `code` | When it appears | Example `message` | |--------|-----------------|-------------------| | `json_mapping_error` | Unknown field name | `Unrecognized property: zzz.` | | `json_mapping_error` | Value of a type other than the expected one | `Could not map property: products[0].quantity.` | | `json_parse_error` | Syntactically invalid JSON | `Error parsing JSON request input.` | | `invalid_accept_header` | An `Accept` header the endpoint cannot serve. The response is `406` | `The requested resource is not available in the requested format.` | | `method_not_allowed` | An HTTP verb not allowed on the endpoint. The response is `405` and includes the `Allow` header | - | The `405` and `415` responses have the same shape. The `param` field names the exact offending field, including inside sub-objects and lists: `estimate.paymentUrl`, `products[0].quantity`. In practice: read `errorText` if it is there, otherwise `errors[].message` and `errors[].param`. **`errorText` can contain HTML.** Stock discharge errors carry markup inside the text: | Error | Markup it contains | |-------|--------------------| | `Nu ai facut nicio achizitie pentru produsul .` | `
` before the suggestion | | `Cantitate stoc insuficienta la ... pentru produsul ...` | `` around the document, the date and the product name | | `Measuring unit a produsului nu are factor de conversie setat.` | a `
` with several paragraphs of help text | Do not show `errorText` as plain text, but do not render it as HTML without sanitising it either. The simplest approach is to take only the first sentence, up to the first `<`: that is where the cause is, the rest is help text meant for the SmartBill Cloud interface. **V1 error format** ```json { "errorText": "Seria nu a fost gasita! Folositi o serie creata in contul de cloud.", "message": "", "number": "", "series": "", "documentUrl": "", "documentId": -1, "documentViewUrl": "" } ``` > **Warning:** a misspelled field in the payload (e.g. `nume` instead of `name`) returns **500** with an HTML response, not JSON. It is not a real server error - check the field names against the schema. The errors below are common to all V1 endpoints (invoice, estimate, receipt, etc.) and relate to the caller, not to the document type.
Authentication
Situation Error Suggestion
Wrong email or token Autentificare esuata. Va rugam verificati datele si incercati din nou. Check the `email` and the V1 API token. If they look correct, check the environment - a test token used on production fails.
companyVatCode missing Firma la care incercati sa va conectati nu mai este disponibila in Cloud. Add `companyVatCode` with the exact CIF of the active company from the Cloud account.
companyVatCode without permissions Firma la care incercati sa va conectati nu este disponibila pentru acest utilizator. The CIF exists, but the authenticated user has no permissions on that company. Use a CIF you have access to or ask the administrator for permissions.
companyVatCode = null Internal Server Error! You are sending `null` as the JSON value instead of the CIF. Send the CIF as a string. Edge case.
Authorization
Situation Error Suggestion
Permission to add invoices Nu aveti dreptul de a adauga facturi The user does not have permission to add invoices. Permissions are changed from the Utilizatori menu in SmartBill Cloud. Ask the account administrator for access.
Permission on the selected series Nu aveti dreptul de a adauga facturi pe seria selectata The user has no permission on this series. Series permissions are changed from the Utilizatori menu in SmartBill Cloud. Ask the account administrator for access.
### API V3 Errors The V3 API returns errors as JSON, using a consistent structure. The `errors` field can contain one or more errors in a single response. **Standard format** ```http HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request Content-Type: application/json ``` ```json { "status": 400, "type": "validation_error", "instance": "/api/v3/clients", "errors": [ { "code": "missing_required_field", "message": "must not be blank", "docUrl": "https://api.smartbill.ro/#v3-error-validation_error", "param": "name" } ] } ``` | Field | Type | Description | |---|---|---| | `status` | integer | HTTP status code of the response. | | `type` | string | General error category. | | `instance` | string | URI of the request that produced the error. | | `errors` | array | List of identified errors. Contains one or more items. | | `errors[].code` | string | Stable code used for programmatic error handling. | | `errors[].message` | string | Explanatory message for diagnostics or display. | | `errors[].docUrl` | string | Documentation URL for that error. | | `errors[].param` | string, optional | Field or parameter that produced the error. | The client application should use `type` and `errors[].code` for decisions. The text in `message` should not be used as a stable identifier. `docUrl` always points to the error category, not to the individual code. The form is `https://api.smartbill.ro/#v3-error-{type}`, for example `https://api.smartbill.ro/#v3-error-authentication_error`. There is no per-`code` URL: every error with the same `type` gets the same `docUrl`. To tell the specific case apart, use `errors[].code`. **Error types** | `type` | Meaning | HTTP codes | Internal link | |---|---|---|---| | `authentication_error` | The API key cannot be authenticated. | `401` | [see table](#v3-error-authentication_error) | | `authorization_error` | The API key is authenticated, but the operation is not allowed. | `403` | [see table](#v3-error-authorization_error) | | `invalid_request_error` | The request, resource or HTTP representation is incorrect. | `400`, `404`, `405`, `406`, `415`, `429` | [see table](#v3-error-invalid_request_error) | | `validation_error` | The request data does not follow the validation rules. | `400` | [see table](#v3-error-validation_error) | | `api_error` | The API cannot process the request because of an internal or temporary cause. | `500`, `503` | [see table](#v3-error-api_error) | **authentication_error - Authentication errors** All errors in this category have `type: authentication_error` and return `401 Unauthorized`. | `code` | Description | Recommended action | |---|---|---| | `missing_authorization` | The `Authorization` header is missing or has an empty value. | Send the `Authorization` header using the Bearer scheme. | | `invalid_authorization_format` | The `Authorization` header does not follow the accepted format. | Check the Bearer scheme, the presence of the token and the absence of extra values. | | `invalid_api_key` | The API key cannot be validated. | Check the key and replace it if it is no longer valid. Do not automatically retry the request with the same key. | | `wrong_environment` | The API key belongs to a different environment than the called route. | Use the API key and URL that belong to the same environment. | The correct authentication header format is: ```http Authorization: Bearer ``` On V3, an `sb_test_` token used on production or a production token used on test returns `401`, even if the token is valid for its own environment. **authorization_error - Authorization errors** All errors in this category have `type: authorization_error` and return `403 Forbidden`. | `code` | Description | Recommended action | |---|---|---| | `insufficient_permissions` | The user associated with the API key does not have the required permission. | Use an authorized user or grant the required permission. | | `subscription_expired` | The company subscription has expired. | Renew the subscription before retrying the request. | | `subscription_limit_exceeded` | The included limit of the company subscription was exceeded. | Reduce usage or change the subscription. | | `subscription_not_found` | The company does not have an associated subscription. | Activate a subscription before retrying the request. | | `subscription_not_valid` | The current subscription does not allow the requested API operation. | Use a subscription that is compatible with the operation. | Authorization errors should not be retried automatically. The same request will continue to receive `403 Forbidden` until permissions or the subscription change. **invalid_request_error - Request errors** Errors in this category have `type: invalid_request_error` and indicate a problem with the route, method, headers, parameters, JSON body or traffic limit. | `code` | HTTP code | Description | Recommended action | |---|---:|---|---| | `company_not_found` | `404` | The company identified by the VAT code was not found. | Check the VAT code and API key access to the company. | | `supplier_not_found` | `404` | The supplier identified by ID was not found. | Check the ID or refresh the supplier list. | | `client_not_found` | `404` | The client identified by ID was not found. | Check the ID or refresh the client list. | | `product_not_found` | `404` | The product identified by ID was not found. | Check the ID or refresh the product list. | | `warehouse_not_found` | `404` | The warehouse identified by ID was not found. | Check the ID or refresh the warehouse list. | | `resource_not_found` | `404` | The requested route or resource does not exist. | Check the API version, URL, path and resource ID. | | `method_not_allowed` | `405` | The HTTP method is not allowed for the requested route. | Use the method shown in the route documentation. | | `invalid_accept_header` | `406` | The `Accept` header does not request the format returned by the API. | Use `Accept: application/json`. | | `invalid_content_type` | `415` | The `Content-Type` header does not declare the format accepted by the API. | For requests with a body, use `Content-Type: application/json`. | | `bad_request` | `400` | The request contains invalid parameters or missing data. | Check the parameters, headers and request body. | | `json_parse_error` | `400` | The request body is not a valid JSON document. | Check quotes, commas, brackets, escape characters and closed strings. | | `json_mapping_error` | `400` | The JSON is syntactically valid, but the structure or values do not match the accepted model. | Correct the field name, type or structure indicated by `param`. | | `missing_vat_code` | `400` | The VAT code required by the operation is missing or empty. | Provide a valid VAT code. | | `malformed_id` | `400` | The resource ID is missing or does not follow the required format. | Use the IDs returned by the API without changing their structure. | | `rate_limit_exceeded` | `429` | The client application exceeded the allowed request limit. | Respect `Retry-After`, use exponential backoff and add random jitter between retries. | The API accepts and returns only `application/json`. For requests with a body, use: ```http Accept: application/json Content-Type: application/json ``` For `json_mapping_error`, the `param` field can contain the full path of the affected property: ```json { "code": "json_mapping_error", "message": "Could not parse property: payment.isCash.", "docUrl": "https://api.smartbill.ro/#v3-error-invalid_request_error", "param": "payment.isCash" } ``` **validation_error - Validation errors** All errors in this category have `type: validation_error` and return `400 Bad Request`. | `code` | Description | Recommended action | |---|---|---| | `invalid_field_type` | The value of a field or parameter does not have the required type. | Send the value using the correct type. | | `invalid_field_value` | The value has the correct type, but does not follow the accepted rules. | Correct the value indicated by `param`. | | `invalid_enum_value` | The value is not part of the accepted option list. | Use one of the documented values for the field. | | `missing_required_field` | A required field is missing, empty or has the value `null`. | Provide the field indicated by `param`. | | `invalid_field_format` | The value does not follow the required format. | Correct the field format, for example a date or email address format. | | `dependency_not_available` | The requested value depends on an option that is unavailable in the request context. | Check the related data and the conditions documented for the route. | A response can contain multiple errors, one for each invalid field: ```json { "status": 400, "type": "validation_error", "instance": "/api/v3/resource", "errors": [ { "code": "missing_required_field", "message": "must not be blank", "docUrl": "https://api.smartbill.ro/#v3-error-validation_error", "param": "name" }, { "code": "invalid_field_format", "message": "must be a well-formed email address", "docUrl": "https://api.smartbill.ro/#v3-error-validation_error", "param": "email" } ] } ``` The client application must process the entire `errors` list, not only the first item. **api_error - API errors** Errors in this category have `type: api_error` and indicate an internal or temporary cause. | `code` | HTTP code | Description | Recommended action | |---|---:|---|---| | `maintenance_in_progress` | `503` | The API is temporarily unavailable because of maintenance. | Respect `Retry-After` and delay requests. | | `rate_limit_temporarily_unavailable` | `503` | The traffic limit evaluation service is temporarily unavailable. | Respect `Retry-After` and use exponential backoff. | | `query_timeout` | `503` | The operation took too long to complete. | Retry the request after one second or adjust the request parameters. | | `internal_error` | `500` | The API encountered an unexpected error. | Retry in a controlled way only if the operation is idempotent or protected against duplication. | `rate_limit_temporarily_unavailable` means the traffic limit could not be evaluated temporarily. It does not mean the client application exceeded the limit. If an `internal_error` persists, keep the `instance` and `code` values for communication with the support team. **Handling errors in the client application** | HTTP code | Recommended retry | Action | |---:|---|---| | `400` | No | Correct the parameters or request body. | | `401` | No, with the same API key | Correct or replace the API key. | | `403` | No | Correct permissions or the subscription. | | `404` | No | Check the route or resource ID. | | `405` | No | Use the correct HTTP method. | | `406` | No | Correct the `Accept` header. | | `415` | No | Correct the `Content-Type` header. | | `429` | Yes | Respect `Retry-After` and apply exponential backoff. | | `500` | Limited | Retry only idempotent operations or operations protected against duplication. | | `503` | Yes | Respect `Retry-After` and apply exponential backoff. | In logs, keep the HTTP code, `type`, each `errors[].code` value, `errors[].param` if present and `instance`. Do not log API keys, the `Authorization` header, access tokens or sensitive request or response data. ## Rate Limiting ### API V1 In **API V1**, access is limited to **30 calls in 10 seconds** per token. If this limit is exceeded, access is blocked for **10 minutes**. SmartBill server responses include headers that show the state of the current 10-second window: | Header | Description | |--------|-------------| | `X-RateLimit-Limit` | How many calls can be made in the 10-second window. For V1, the value is `30`. | | `X-RateLimit-Remaining` | Number of calls remaining in the current 10-second window. | | `X-RateLimit-Reset` | Unix timestamp when the next 10-second window starts. | ### API V3 In **API V3**, rate limits apply to authenticated requests to public endpoints and are calculated for the user and company associated with the request. If the same user and company use multiple tokens, services or applications, the requests are accumulated under the same limits. Unless you received different limits by contract or from SmartBill, the following standard values apply: | Category | Standard limit | |----------|----------------| | Read (`GET`, `HEAD`) | 60 requests per 10 seconds | | Write (`POST`, `PUT`, `PATCH`, `DELETE` and other non-`GET`/non-`HEAD` methods) | 30 requests per 10 seconds | | Daily total | 50,000 requests per day | The daily limit normally resets at midnight in the Romania timezone (`Europe/Bucharest`). Limits may be different for some accounts or companies, so API clients must read the effective values from the response headers. When the V3 limit is exceeded, you get **429 Too Many Requests** with the `Retry-After` header indicating the minimum number of seconds to wait before retrying: ```json { "status": 429, "type": "invalid_request_error", "instance": "/api/v3/{vatCode}/...", "errors": [ { "code": "rate_limit_exceeded", "message": "Rate limit exceeded. Please try again in 10 seconds.", "docUrl": "https://api.smartbill.ro/#v3-error-invalid_request_error" } ] } ``` The error message is informative and may vary depending on the wait duration. Your integration should rely on HTTP status `429`, on `code: rate_limit_exceeded` and on the `Retry-After` header. If the application continues to send requests after exceeding the limit, the `Retry-After` value may increase progressively. In the standard configuration, penalty intervals may increase up to several minutes: `5, 10, 20, 40, 80, 160, 300, 600` seconds. These values may be different for some accounts or companies. Always use the value received in the `Retry-After` header. API V3 responses for which rate limiting was calculated include: | Header | Description | |--------|-------------| | `X-RateLimit-Limit` | Effective limit for the short window applicable to the current request. For `GET`/`HEAD` this is the read limit; for other methods this is the write limit. | | `X-RateLimit-Remaining` | Number of requests remaining in the current short window. | | `X-RateLimit-Reset` | Unix timestamp, in seconds, when the short window or current wait interval resets. | | `X-RateLimit-Daily-Limit` | Effective daily limit. | | `X-RateLimit-Daily-Remaining` | Number of requests remaining until the daily limit resets. | | `X-RateLimit-Daily-Reset` | Unix timestamp, in seconds, when the daily limit resets. | | `Retry-After` | Present on responses where the client must wait before retrying, for example `429 Too Many Requests` or `503 Service Unavailable`. The value is in seconds. | If the daily limit is exhausted, the API also responds with **429 Too Many Requests**. In this case, `X-RateLimit-Daily-Remaining` will be `0`, and `X-RateLimit-Daily-Reset` indicates when the daily limit resets. In rare cases, the API cannot temporarily evaluate the rate limit state. In this situation the response is **503 Service Unavailable**, not `429`, and includes `Retry-After`. - Implement retry with backoff for `429 Too Many Requests` responses and temporary `503 Service Unavailable` responses that include `Retry-After` - Wait at least the number of seconds indicated by `Retry-After` before retrying - Monitor `X-RateLimit-Remaining` and `X-RateLimit-Daily-Remaining`; when the values approach `0`, temporarily reduce the request rate - Use pagination and batch processing where possible (e.g. do not create invoices one by one in rapid loops)

This section covers the full lifecycle of an invoice: issuing, cancelling, restoring, reversing and deleting.

Available operations:
- Issue a simple invoice or one based on an estimate
- Issue a draft invoice
- Issue an invoice with a payment link, in foreign currency, with stock deduction
- Retrieve invoice PDF
- Check invoice payment status
- Send invoice by email

Operations with estimates - create, view PDF, cancel, delete.

Similar to invoices, but for estimate-type documents.

tags.name: Payments
tags.description:
Payment/collection operations.

**Payment types** - the values are in Romanian and are sent in the `type` field:
- Card
- Card online
- Chitanta (receipt)
- Bon (fiscal receipt)
- Ordin plata (payment order)
- CEC (cheque)
- Bilet ordin (promissory note)
- Mandat postal (postal money order)
- Extras de cont (bank statement)
- Ramburs (cash on delivery)
- Alta incasare (other payment)

Letter case does not matter: `Ramburs`, `ramburs` and `RAMBURS` are treated the same. Extra
spaces invalidate the value - `Ramburs ` or `Card  online` return `404` with
`Tipul documentului nu a fost gasit pe server!`.

Only `Chitanta` and `Bon` generate a separate document. The other types record the payment
without issuing a document, and the response comes back without `number` and `series`.

post.description:
Issues a new invoice. You can issue the invoice as a draft, which you finalize later from the SmartBill interface. **Got an error while issuing the invoice?** **Authentication and authorization errors are common to all V1 endpoints.** For email/token, `companyVatCode`, company or series rights, see [API V1 Errors](#api-1/description/api-v1-errors). Below you will find only the errors specific to issuing an invoice.
Document data and series
Situation Error Suggestion
Series does not exist in the account Seria nu a fost gasita! Folositi o serie creata in contul de cloud. The series must be defined in SmartBill Cloud. Send the invoice series in `seriesName`, exactly as configured in the account.
The account reached the maximum number of documents allowed by its subscription package Pentru acest pachet s-a emis numarul maxim de documente permis The limit comes from the SmartBill Cloud subscription, not from the API, so it cannot be lifted from the integration. Check the package in the account.
Currency missing or misspelled Moneda nu a fost gasita pe server! Check the currency sent in `currency`. Accepted values are listed in the field schema.
Document date in the wrong format Data documentului trebuie sa fie de forma yyyy-MM-dd. Send `issueDate` in `yyyy-MM-dd` format, for example `2026-06-15`.
sendEmail without a recipient address Trebuie specificata adresa de email a clientului. When `sendEmail` is `true`, fill in the recipient address in `email.to` or in `client.email`.
sendEmail without an email server Server-ul de email nu a fost configurat. The account does not have an email server configured. Go to SmartBill Cloud and configure your own email server from Configurare > Email.
Client
Situation Error Suggestion
The client object is missing tara trebuie specificata Send `client` with at least `name` and `country`.
client.name empty or null Client invalid! Send a valid `client.name` (not empty, not `null`).
client.country is missing tara trebuie specificata Fill in `client.country`, e.g. `Romania`.
Duplicate client in the catalog Clientul exista deja pe server A client with the same name but a different CIF already exists. Delete the duplicate from the catalog.
Products, VAT and discounts
Situation Error Suggestion
Empty `products` list invoiceProducts trebuie specificat si trebuie sa contina cel putin un element Send at least one product in `products`.
products[].name missing name trebuie specificat pentru fiecare produs Send `name` for each product.
products[].measuringUnitName missing measuringUnitName trebuie specificat pentru fiecare produs Send `measuringUnitName` (case-sensitive, must exist in the account).
Product VAT rate does not exist Cota tva a produsului ... nu a fost gasita pe server! Use a VAT rate that exists in the account.
Product without a VAT rate set Trebuie sa setezi o cota tva pentru produsul ... Set `taxPercentage` for each product.
Document with a discount only Nu poti sa emiti un document care contine doar un discount. Trebuie sa ai si produse / servicii adaugate. Add products too, not just a discount line.
Percentage discount without a percentage Trebuie sa introduceti valoarea procentului! Send `discountPercentage` on the discount line.
Product without a code Produsul ... nu are codul specificat. If the company uses product codes, send `code` for each product.
Product without a VAT rate in the catalog Produsul ... nu are cota tva setata in cloud. Setati o cota din nomenclatorul de produse. Set the product VAT rate in Nomenclatoare > Produse.
No default VAT rate Cota default nu a fost gasita pe server! Mark a VAT rate as default in Configurare > Cote TVA.
Discount rate does not exist Cota ... nu a fost gasita pe server! Use a VAT rate predefined in the account.
Discount on products with different VAT rates La aplicarea unui discount pentru produse cu cote tva diferite, trebuie sa specifici si cota tva a discountului. Also specify the VAT rate of the discount.
Value discount without a value discountValue trebuie specificat pentru fiecare produs de tip discount Send `discountValue` on the discount line.
Product currency does not exist Moneda nu a fost gasita pe server! Send a value accepted by the `products[].currency` field schema or omit the field.
Different reference currency Nu puteti emite documente in ... cu moneda de referinta a produselor in ... ! The document currency and the reference currency must match (when not RON).
Price in a currency other than the document Aveti produse care au pretul in alta moneda decat cea a facturii. Enable working with a reference price in foreign currency in the account.
Over 400 lines on the document Numarul maxim acceptat de 400 intrari pe document a fost depasit. Maximum 400 line items per document.
Payment
Situation Error Suggestion
Payment without a type (payment.type missing) type trebuie specificat pentru incasare Send the payment type in `payment.type`.
Payment without isCash isCash trebuie specificat pentru incasare Send `payment.isCash` (`true`/`false`) when you add a payment.
Payment without a value (payment.value missing) value trebuie specificat pentru incasare Send the payment amount in `payment.value`.
Payment type does not exist Tipul documentului nu a fost gasit pe server! The payment type sent does not exist. Use a valid type (for example `Chitanta`, `Ordin de plata`, `Card`).
Payment series does not exist in the account Seria nu a fost gasita! Folositi o serie creata in contul de cloud. The payment series must be defined in the SmartBill Cloud account.
From estimate
Situation Error Suggestion
Source estimate does not exist Factura proforma ... nu a fost gasita! The estimate you want to issue the invoice from was not found. Check in SmartBill Cloud whether the document still exists and whether you sent the estimate series and number correctly.
Source estimate without products Proforma nu contine produse! The estimate you are issuing the invoice from has no products. Check in SmartBill Cloud whether that estimate has products.
Stock and warehouses
Situation Error Suggestion
Warehouse missing on product (with useStock) Gestiunea predatoare nu este setata pentru produsul Produs Test API Erori. When `useStock` is `true`, send an existing warehouse in `products[].warehouseName`.
Warehouse does not exist in the account Gestiunea predatoare NONEXISTENT_WAREHOUSE a produsului Produs Test API Erori nu a fost gasita. Check that `warehouseName` is spelled correctly and that the warehouse was created beforehand in the Cloud account.
Invalid warehouse Gestiunea predatoare este invalida! The warehouse sent is not valid. Check `warehouseName` and the warehouses defined in the Cloud account.
Stock module inactive on the account Modulul stoc nu este activ! The account you are issuing from does not have the stock module enabled. Contact us at api@smartbill.ro.
Product without stock (no purchase) Nu ai facut nicio achizitie pentru produsul ... First add stock for the product or issue the document without stock deduction. Check the product code and name (case-sensitive).
Insufficient stock in the warehouse Cantitate stoc insuficienta ... There is not enough stock in the chosen warehouse. Change the warehouse or issue with `useStock` `false` and deduct the stock later from the Cloud account.
Product code that does not match the one in stock Exista deja pe stoc un produs cu numele ... si codul ... The product code sent does not exactly match the one in SmartBill. The code is case-sensitive (for example `25xl` vs `25XL`).
Measuring unit without a conversion factor Measuring unit ... nu are factor de conversie setat. The measuring unit must be entered exactly as in the Cloud account for the product. The parameter is case-sensitive.
Document date earlier than the initial stock import Nu poti adauga documente cu tranzactii pe stoc la data anterioara datei importului de stoc initial ... Choose an `issueDate` later than the initial stock import date for that warehouse.
- -- ## Issuing types
1. Issue a simple invoice The minimum required fields for a valid invoice. Recommended starting point for new integrations or simple cases. ```json { "companyVatCode": "COMPANY_VAT_CODE", "seriesName": "INVOICE_SERIES", "issueDate": "2026-08-31", "client": { "name": "Client SRL", "country": "Romania" }, "products": [{ "name": "Produs 1", "code": "PRD001", "quantity": 1, "measuringUnitName": "buc", "taxPercentage": 21, "price": 10 }] } ```
2. Issue a complete invoice A complex payload that combines several options in a single call - useful as a reference when integrating scenarios that go beyond a simple invoice. ```json { "companyVatCode": "COMPANY_VAT_CODE", "seriesName": "INVOICE_SERIES", "isDraft": false, "issueDate": "2026-08-31", "dueDate": "2026-09-30", "deliveryDate": "2026-08-31", "paymentDate": "2026-08-31", "language": "RO", "currency": "RON", "precision": 2, "useStock": false, "useIntraCif": false, "usePaymentTax": false, "useEstimateDetails": false, "delegateName": "Ion Popescu", "delegateIdentityCard": "AB 123456", "delegateAuto": "B-123-ABC", "issuerCnp": "1234567890123", "issuerName": "Maria Ionescu", "client": { "name": "Client SRL", "vatCode": "RO22222222", "code": "CLI001", "regCom": "J40/1234/2020", "isTaxPayer": true, "address": "Str. Lalelei 1", "city": "Sector 1", "county": "Bucuresti", "country": "Romania", "email": "client@example.com", "phone": "0722000000", "contact": "Andrei Popa", "iban": "RO49AAAA1B31007593840000", "bank": "BCR", "saveToDb": false }, "products": [ { "name": "Servicii consultanta", "code": "SRV001", "productDescription": "Servicii de consultanta IT", "translatedName": "Consulting services", "measuringUnitName": "ora", "translatedMeasuringUnit": "hour", "quantity": 1, "price": 100, "taxName": "Normala", "taxPercentage": 21, "isService": true, "saveToDb": false }, { "name": "Discount valoric", "isDiscount": true, "numberOfItems": 1, "discountType": 1, "discountValue": -10, "measuringUnitName": "buc", "taxPercentage": 21 }, { "name": "Produs 1", "code": "PRD001", "quantity": 2, "price": 200, "measuringUnitName": "buc", "taxName": "Normala", "taxPercentage": 21, "isService": false, "saveToDb": false }, { "name": "Discount procentual 10%", "isDiscount": true, "numberOfItems": 1, "discountType": 2, "discountPercentage": 10, "measuringUnitName": "buc", "taxPercentage": 21 } ], "payment": { "value": 450, "type": "Ordin plata", "isCash": false }, "paymentUrl": "", "sendEmail": false, "email": { "to": "client@example.com", "cc": "", "bcc": "" }, "observations": "Marfa se ridica de la sediu in termen de 5 zile lucratoare", "mentions": "Plata se face in contul IBAN specificat in contract" } ```
3. Issue an invoice with a payment link Issues the invoice with a payment link tied to the 'Plateste cu cardul' button on the document. Requires a Netopia, euPlatesc or Stripe account configured in Configurare > Integrari. Set `paymentUrl: "Generate URL"` to enable link generation. ```json { "companyVatCode": "COMPANY_VAT_CODE", "seriesName": "INVOICE_SERIES", "issueDate": "2026-08-31", "client": { "name": "Client SRL", "vatCode": "RO22222222", "isTaxPayer": true, "address": "Str. Lalelei 1", "city": "Sector 1", "county": "Bucuresti", "country": "Romania", "email": "client@example.com" }, "products": [{ "name": "Produs 1", "code": "PRD001", "quantity": 1, "price": 100, "measuringUnitName": "buc", "taxPercentage": 21 }], "paymentUrl": "Generate URL" } ```
4. Issue an invoice with stock deduction Issues the invoice and deducts the products' stock from the warehouse. The warehouse must already exist in SmartBill Cloud and have stock available for the invoiced products. Set `useStock: true` and specify `warehouseName` on each product. > **Product name on stock deduction.** The product is matched by `code`. If the value in `name` differs from the name in the nomenclature, it automatically overwrites the product name in the nomenclature, regardless of the `saveToDb` value. > > *Example:* the product `Apa minerala` (code `A1`) exists in the nomenclature. When issuing an invoice with stock deduction on code `A1` while sending `"name": "Apa minerala 1.5"`, the product name in the nomenclature becomes `Apa minerala 1.5`. > > To keep the SmartBill name, so that the name sent via API is used only on the invoice without modifying the nomenclature, set `useSBProductName: true` in the product parameters. Requires the "Foloseste cod produs" setting enabled for the company. ```json { "companyVatCode": "COMPANY_VAT_CODE", "seriesName": "INVOICE_SERIES", "issueDate": "2026-08-31", "client": { "name": "Client SRL", "vatCode": "RO22222222", "isTaxPayer": true, "address": "Str. Lalelei 1", "city": "Sector 1", "county": "Bucuresti", "country": "Romania", "email": "client@example.com" }, "useStock": true, "products": [{ "name": "Produs 1", "code": "PRD001", "quantity": 1, "price": 100, "measuringUnitName": "buc", "warehouseName": "WAREHOUSE_NAME", "taxPercentage": 21 }] } ```
5. Issue a draft invoice Issues the invoice in draft state, without an assigned number. The document remains a draft until finalized manually from SmartBill Cloud. Set `isDraft: true`. ```json { "companyVatCode": "COMPANY_VAT_CODE", "isDraft": true, "seriesName": "INVOICE_SERIES", "issueDate": "2026-08-31", "client": { "name": "Client SRL", "vatCode": "RO22222222", "isTaxPayer": true, "address": "Str. Lalelei 1", "city": "Sector 1", "county": "Bucuresti", "country": "Romania", "email": "client@example.com" }, "products": [{ "name": "Produs 1", "code": "PRD001", "quantity": 1, "price": 100, "measuringUnitName": "buc", "taxPercentage": 21 }] } ```
6. Issue an invoice with discounts Discounts are added as separate lines with `isDiscount: true`. `numberOfItems` sets how many immediately preceding products the discount applies to. For a value discount, set `discountType: 1` and use `discountValue`. For a percentage discount, set `discountType: 2` and use `discountPercentage`; the percentage must be greater than 0. ```json { "companyVatCode": "COMPANY_VAT_CODE", "seriesName": "INVOICE_SERIES", "issueDate": "2026-08-31", "client": { "name": "Client SRL", "vatCode": "RO22222222", "isTaxPayer": true, "address": "Str. Lalelei 1", "city": "Sector 1", "county": "Bucuresti", "country": "Romania", "email": "client@example.com" }, "products": [ { "name": "Produs 1", "code": "PRD001", "quantity": 1, "price": 100, "measuringUnitName": "buc", "taxPercentage": 21 }, { "name": "Discount valoric", "isDiscount": true, "numberOfItems": 1, "discountType": 1, "discountValue": -10, "measuringUnitName": "buc", "taxPercentage": 21 }, { "name": "Produs 2", "code": "PRD002", "quantity": 1, "price": 200, "measuringUnitName": "buc", "taxPercentage": 21 }, { "name": "Discount procentual 10%", "isDiscount": true, "numberOfItems": 1, "discountType": 2, "discountPercentage": 10, "measuringUnitName": "buc", "taxPercentage": 21 } ] } ```
7. Issue an invoice with services Mark service-type products with `isService: true`. Services are automatically excluded from stock deduction when `useStock: true` is set at the invoice level. ```json { "companyVatCode": "COMPANY_VAT_CODE", "seriesName": "INVOICE_SERIES", "issueDate": "2026-08-31", "client": { "name": "Client SRL", "vatCode": "RO22222222", "isTaxPayer": true, "address": "Str. Lalelei 1", "city": "Sector 1", "county": "Bucuresti", "country": "Romania", "email": "client@example.com" }, "products": [{ "name": "Servicii consultanta", "code": "SRV001", "quantity": 1, "price": 100, "measuringUnitName": "ora", "taxPercentage": 21, "isService": true }] } ```
8. Issue an invoice with a due date Add `dueDate` to specify the invoice due date. ```json { "companyVatCode": "COMPANY_VAT_CODE", "seriesName": "INVOICE_SERIES", "issueDate": "2026-08-31", "dueDate": "2026-09-30", "client": { "name": "Client SRL", "vatCode": "RO22222222", "isTaxPayer": true, "address": "Str. Lalelei 1", "city": "Sector 1", "county": "Bucuresti", "country": "Romania", "email": "client@example.com" }, "products": [{ "name": "Produs 1", "code": "PRD001", "quantity": 1, "price": 100, "measuringUnitName": "buc", "taxPercentage": 21 }] } ```
9. Issue an invoice as paid Issues the invoice and records the payment at the same time, in a single call, through the `payment` object. Useful when the customer has already paid the order in your online store. ```json { "companyVatCode": "COMPANY_VAT_CODE", "seriesName": "INVOICE_SERIES", "issueDate": "2026-08-31", "client": { "name": "Client SRL", "vatCode": "RO22222222", "isTaxPayer": true, "address": "Str. Lalelei 1", "city": "Sector 1", "county": "Bucuresti", "country": "Romania", "email": "client@example.com" }, "products": [{ "name": "Produs 1", "code": "PRD001", "quantity": 1, "price": 100, "measuringUnitName": "buc", "taxPercentage": 21 }], "payment": { "value": 100, "paymentSeries": "RECEIPT_SERIES", "type": "Chitanta", "isCash": true } } ```
10. Issue an invoice with email sending Issues the invoice and automatically emails it to the client. Set `sendEmail: true` and specify the address in `email.to`. The sender address and template are configured from [Configurare > Email](https://cloud.smartbill.ro/core/configurare_mailuri/). ```json { "companyVatCode": "COMPANY_VAT_CODE", "seriesName": "INVOICE_SERIES", "issueDate": "2026-08-31", "sendEmail": true, "email": { "to": "client@example.com", "cc": "", "bcc": "" }, "client": { "name": "Client SRL", "vatCode": "RO22222222", "isTaxPayer": true, "address": "Str. Lalelei 1", "city": "Sector 1", "county": "Bucuresti", "country": "Romania", "email": "client@example.com" }, "products": [{ "name": "Produs 1", "code": "PRD001", "quantity": 1, "price": 100, "measuringUnitName": "buc", "taxPercentage": 21 }] } ```
11. Issue an invoice in foreign currency Issues the invoice in foreign currency. Set `currency` and `exchangeRate` at the invoice level, and `currency` on each product with the same currency - the exchange rate appears on the invoice alongside the RON equivalent. `exchangeRate` is optional - if not specified, the rate from [Preferinte personale](https://cloud.smartbill.ro/core/configurare/preferinte-personale/) is used (the "Curs valutar preluat de pe Internet" section: today's or yesterday's rate, with an optional percentage markup). ```json { "companyVatCode": "COMPANY_VAT_CODE", "seriesName": "INVOICE_SERIES", "issueDate": "2026-08-31", "currency": "EUR", "exchangeRate": 4.97, "client": { "name": "Client SRL", "vatCode": "RO22222222", "isTaxPayer": true, "address": "Str. Lalelei 1", "city": "Sector 1", "county": "Bucuresti", "country": "Romania", "email": "client@example.com" }, "products": [ { "name": "Produs 1", "code": "PRD001", "quantity": 1, "price": 100, "measuringUnitName": "buc", "taxPercentage": 21, "currency": "EUR" } ] } ```
12. Issue an invoice with a reference price in foreign currency Useful when contracts are in foreign currency but you invoice in RON - for example, a 100 EUR maintenance subscription invoiced at the daily rate. Requires enabling the "Am preturi cu moneda de referinta in valuta" option from [Configurare > Generale](https://cloud.smartbill.ro/documente/preferinte-generale/) in SmartBill Cloud. Set `currency` at the product level with the contract currency and `currency` at the invoice level with the issuing currency. `exchangeRate` on the product is optional - if not specified, the rate from [Preferinte personale](https://cloud.smartbill.ro/core/configurare/preferinte-personale/) is used (the "Curs valutar preluat de pe Internet" section: today's or yesterday's rate, with an optional percentage markup). ```json { "companyVatCode": "COMPANY_VAT_CODE", "seriesName": "INVOICE_SERIES", "issueDate": "2026-08-31", "currency": "RON", "client": { "name": "Client SRL", "vatCode": "RO22222222", "isTaxPayer": true, "address": "Str. Lalelei 1", "city": "Sector 1", "county": "Bucuresti", "country": "Romania", "email": "client@example.com" }, "products": [ { "name": "Produs 1", "code": "PRD001", "quantity": 1, "price": 497, "measuringUnitName": "buc", "taxPercentage": 21, "currency": "EUR", "exchangeRate": 4.97 } ] } ```
13. Issue an invoice with an intra-community VAT code If you are registered in the One Stop Shop electronic system, go to your SmartBill account at [Configurare > Date Firma](https://cloud.smartbill.ro/core/configurare/date-firma/) and fill in the `CIF intracomunitar` field. If you need an OSS CIF, use the `Genereaza CIF OSS` option shown next to the field. After configuration, set `useIntraCif: true` to issue the invoice with this CIF. ```json { "companyVatCode": "COMPANY_VAT_CODE", "useIntraCif": true, "seriesName": "INVOICE_SERIES", "issueDate": "2026-08-31", "client": { "name": "Company GmbH", "vatCode": "DE123456789", "address": "Musterstrasse 1", "city": "Berlin", "county": "Berlin", "country": "Germania" }, "products": [{ "name": "Servicii consultanta", "code": "SRV001", "quantity": 1, "price": 100, "measuringUnitName": "buc", "taxPercentage": 0, "taxName": "Taxare inversa", "isService": true }] } ```
14. Issue an invoice - non-VAT-paying issuer If your company is not a VAT payer, you do not need to fill in the VAT-related fields on the products. ```json { "companyVatCode": "COMPANY_VAT_CODE", "seriesName": "INVOICE_SERIES", "issueDate": "2026-08-31", "client": { "name": "Client SRL", "vatCode": "RO22222222", "isTaxPayer": true, "address": "Str. Lalelei 1", "city": "Sector 1", "county": "Bucuresti", "country": "Romania", "email": "client@example.com" }, "products": [{ "name": "Produs 1", "code": "PRD001", "quantity": 1, "price": 100, "measuringUnitName": "buc" }] } ```
15. Issue an invoice with different VAT rates Add products with different VAT rates as separate lines with the corresponding `taxPercentage` - SmartBill automatically groups by rate in the document. For the 0% rate, always also specify a `taxName` that exists in the account, for example `Taxare inversa`, `TVA Inclus`, `SDD` or `SFDD` - without it, the API defaults to `Taxare inversa`, regardless of the correct tax regime. ```json { "companyVatCode": "COMPANY_VAT_CODE", "seriesName": "INVOICE_SERIES", "issueDate": "2026-08-31", "client": { "name": "Client SRL", "vatCode": "RO22222222", "isTaxPayer": true, "address": "Str. Lalelei 1", "city": "Sector 1", "county": "Bucuresti", "country": "Romania", "email": "client@example.com" }, "products": [ { "name": "Produs standard", "code": "PRD001", "quantity": 1, "price": 100, "measuringUnitName": "buc", "taxPercentage": 21 }, { "name": "Aliment", "code": "PRD002", "quantity": 1, "price": 100, "measuringUnitName": "buc", "taxPercentage": 11 }, { "name": "Produs scutit", "code": "PRD003", "quantity": 1, "price": 100, "measuringUnitName": "buc", "taxPercentage": 0, "taxName": "SDD" } ] } ```
16. Issue an invoice in a foreign language The invoice is issued in Romanian (`RO`) by default. To issue it in another language, set the `language` parameter at invoice level. post.description:
Reverses an existing invoice. Send the original invoice series and number; `issueDate` is optional. **Got an error while issuing the reversal invoice?** **Authentication and authorization errors are common to all V1 endpoints.** For email/token, `companyVatCode`, company or series rights, see [API V1 Errors](#api-1/description/api-v1-errors). Below you will find only the errors specific to reversal.
Reversal invoice issuance errors
Situation Error Suggestion
number is missing Numarul facturii trebuie specificat in parametrul 'number'! Send `number` with the number of the invoice to reverse, exactly as in the account, for example `3738`.
seriesName is missing Seria facturii trebuie specificata in parametrul 'seriesname'! Send `seriesName` with the series of the invoice to reverse, for example `fac`.
The invoice to reverse does not exist Factura cu seria si numarul fac99999999 nu a fost gasita! Check `seriesName` and `number`. The series plus number combination must exist in the account.
The invoice has already been reversed Factura este deja stornata. An invoice can be reversed only once. Check whether a reversal invoice already exists for this document.
The invoice to reverse is cancelled Factura fac3830 este anulata. A cancelled invoice cannot be reversed. Restore it first (if you really want to reverse it) or reverse an active invoice.
You are trying to reverse an invoice that is itself a reversal Factura fac3739 este de tip storno. Nu se poate storna. A reversal document cannot be reversed. Send the original invoice in `number`, not the reversal invoice.
issueDate earlier than the original invoice date Data emiterii facturii storno nu poate fi anterioara datei emiterii facturii stornate. Send an `issueDate` equal to or later than the reversed invoice date.
issueDate in the wrong format Could not map property: issueDate. Send `issueDate` in `yyyy-MM-dd` format, for example `2026-07-15`.
- -- ## Reversal types
1. Simple reversal Reversing an existing invoice. The reversal automatically takes the original invoice series and gets the current date. ```json { "companyVatCode": "COMPANY_VAT_CODE", "seriesName": "INVOICE_SERIES", "number": "3738" } ```
2. Reversal with a specific date Set `issueDate` when you want the reversal invoice to have a date different from the current one. The date cannot be earlier than the original invoice date. ```json { "companyVatCode": "COMPANY_VAT_CODE", "seriesName": "INVOICE_SERIES", "number": "3738", "issueDate": "2026-08-31" } ```

get.description:
Downloads the invoice in PDF format. The parameters are sent in the URL (query string).

Through the API, an invoice can be retrieved only as a PDF file. There is no endpoint for retrieving the invoice as JSON or XML.

A successful response is a binary file (`application/octet-stream`), sent with `Content-Disposition: attachment` and a filename built from `factura` + series + number - for example `facturafac3880.pdf`.

The response `Content-Type` mirrors the `Accept` header sent in the request: if you ask for `Accept: application/json`, the response is labelled `application/json`, even though the body is the same PDF. Do not rely on `Content-Type` to decide how to handle the response.

**Do not send `Accept: application/pdf`.** The most natural value is the only one that fails: the response is `406` with `{"code": "invalid_accept_header"}`, not the PDF. What works is `application/octet-stream`, `*/*`, `application/json`, or omitting the `Accept` header entirely.

Careful with errors: this endpoint does **not** return an API error. Any missing parameter or nonexistent document leads to `502 Bad Gateway`, with an HTML body that cannot be parsed programmatically. Unlike this one, [the estimate PDF](#tag/estimates/GET/estimate/pdf) returns `400` with `errorText` in JSON.

post.description:
Issues a new estimate. You can issue the estimate as a draft and finalize it later from the SmartBill interface. **Got an error while issuing the estimate?** Errors when issuing the estimate **Authentication and authorization errors are common to all V1 endpoints.** For email/token, `companyVatCode`, rights on the company or on the series, see [API V1 Errors](#api-1/description/api-v1-errors). Below you will find only the errors specific to issuing an estimate.
Document data and series
Situation Error Suggestion
Series does not exist in the account Seria nu a fost gasita! Folositi o serie creata in contul de cloud. The series must be defined in SmartBill Cloud. Send the estimate series in `seriesName`, exactly as configured in the account.
The account reached the maximum number of documents allowed by its subscription package Pentru acest pachet s-a emis numarul maxim de documente permis The limit comes from the SmartBill Cloud subscription, not from the API, so it cannot be lifted from the integration. Check the package in the account.
Currency does not exist or is misspelled Moneda nu a fost gasita pe server! Check the currency sent in `currency`. Accepted values are listed in the field schema.
Document date in the wrong format Data documentului trebuie sa fie de forma yyyy-MM-dd. Send `issueDate` in `yyyy-MM-dd` format, for example `2026-06-15`.
sendEmail without a recipient address Trebuie specificata adresa de email a clientului. When `sendEmail` is `true`, fill in the recipient address in `email.to` or in `client.email`.
sendEmail without an email server Server-ul de email nu a fost configurat. The account has no email server configured. Go to SmartBill Cloud and set up your own email server from Configurare > Email.
Client
Situation Error Suggestion
The client object is missing tara trebuie specificata Send `client` with at least `name` and `country`.
client.name empty or null Client invalid! Send a valid `client.name` (not empty, not `null`).
client.country is missing tara trebuie specificata Fill in `client.country`, e.g. `Romania`.
Duplicate client in the registry Clientul exista deja pe server A client with the same name but a different CIF already exists. Delete the duplicate from the registry.
Products, VAT and discounts
Situation Error Suggestion
Empty `products` list estimateProducts trebuie specificat si trebuie sa contina cel putin un element Send at least one product in `products`.
products[].name missing name trebuie specificat pentru fiecare produs Send `name` for each product.
products[].measuringUnitName missing measuringUnitName trebuie specificat pentru fiecare produs Send `measuringUnitName` (case-sensitive, must exist in the account).
Product VAT rate does not exist Cota tva a produsului ... nu a fost gasita pe server! Use a VAT rate that exists in the account.
Product without a VAT rate set Trebuie sa setezi o cota tva pentru produsul ... Set `taxPercentage` for each product.
Document with a discount only Nu poti sa emiti un document care contine doar un discount. Trebuie sa ai si produse / servicii adaugate. Add products as well, not just a discount line.
Percentage discount without a percentage Trebuie sa introduceti valoarea procentului! Send `discountPercentage` on the discount line.
Product without a code Produsul ... nu are codul specificat. If the company uses product codes, send `code` for each product.
Product without a VAT rate in the registry Produsul ... nu are cota tva setata in cloud. Setati o cota din nomenclatorul de produse. Set the product VAT rate in Nomenclatoare > Produse.
No default VAT rate Cota default nu a fost gasita pe server! Mark a VAT rate as default in Configurare > Cote TVA.
Discount VAT rate does not exist Cota ... nu a fost gasita pe server! Use a VAT rate predefined in the account.
Discount on products with different VAT rates La aplicarea unui discount pentru produse cu cote tva diferite, trebuie sa specifici si cota tva a discountului. Also specify the VAT rate of the discount.
Value discount without a value discountValue trebuie specificat pentru fiecare produs de tip discount Send `discountValue` on the discount line.
Product currency does not exist Moneda nu a fost gasita pe server! Send a value accepted by the `products[].currency` field schema or omit the field.
Different reference currency Nu puteti emite documente in ... cu moneda de referinta a produselor in ... ! The document currency and the reference currency must match (when it is not RON).
Price in a currency other than the document Aveti produse care au pretul in alta moneda decat cea a proformei. Enable working with a reference price in foreign currency in the account.
More than 400 lines on the document Numarul maxim acceptat de 400 intrari pe document a fost depasit. Maximum 400 items per document.
## Issuing types
1. Issue a simple estimate The minimum required fields for a valid estimate. Recommended starting point for new integrations or simple cases. ```json { "companyVatCode": "COMPANY_VAT_CODE", "seriesName": "ESTIMATE_SERIES", "issueDate": "2026-08-31", "client": { "name": "Client SRL", "country": "Romania" }, "products": [{ "name": "Produs 1", "code": "PRD001", "quantity": 1, "measuringUnitName": "buc", "taxPercentage": 21, "price": 10 }] } ```
2. Issue a complete estimate A complex payload that combines several options in a single call - useful as a reference when integrating scenarios that go beyond the simple estimate. ```json { "companyVatCode": "COMPANY_VAT_CODE", "seriesName": "ESTIMATE_SERIES", "isDraft": false, "issueDate": "2026-08-31", "dueDate": "2026-09-30", "deliveryDate": "2026-08-31", "language": "RO", "currency": "RON", "precision": 2, "useIntraCif": false, "delegateName": "Ion Popescu", "delegateIdentityCard": "AB 123456", "delegateAuto": "B-123-ABC", "issuerCnp": "1234567890123", "issuerName": "Maria Ionescu", "client": { "name": "Client SRL", "vatCode": "RO22222222", "code": "CLI001", "regCom": "J40/1234/2020", "isTaxPayer": true, "address": "Str. Lalelei 1", "city": "Sector 1", "county": "Bucuresti", "country": "Romania", "email": "client@example.com", "phone": "0722000000", "contact": "Andrei Popa", "iban": "RO49AAAA1B31007593840000", "bank": "BCR", "saveToDb": false }, "products": [ { "name": "Servicii consultanta", "code": "SRV001", "productDescription": "Servicii de consultanta IT", "translatedName": "Consulting services", "measuringUnitName": "ora", "translatedMeasuringUnit": "hour", "quantity": 1, "price": 100, "taxName": "Normala", "taxPercentage": 21, "isService": true, "saveToDb": false }, { "name": "Discount valoric", "isDiscount": true, "numberOfItems": 1, "discountType": 1, "discountValue": -10, "measuringUnitName": "buc", "taxPercentage": 21 }, { "name": "Produs 1", "code": "PRD001", "quantity": 2, "price": 200, "measuringUnitName": "buc", "taxName": "Normala", "taxPercentage": 21, "isService": false, "saveToDb": false }, { "name": "Discount procentual 10%", "isDiscount": true, "numberOfItems": 1, "discountType": 2, "discountPercentage": 10, "measuringUnitName": "buc", "taxPercentage": 21 } ], "paymentUrl": "", "sendEmail": false, "email": { "to": "client@example.com", "cc": "", "bcc": "" }, "observations": "Marfa se ridica de la sediu in termen de 5 zile lucratoare", "mentions": "Plata se face in contul IBAN specificat in contract" } ```
3. Issue an estimate with a payment link Issues the estimate with a payment link tied to the 'Plateste cu cardul' button on the document. Requires a Netopia, euPlatesc or Stripe account configured in Configurare > Integrari. Set `paymentUrl: "Generate URL"` to enable link generation. ```json { "companyVatCode": "COMPANY_VAT_CODE", "seriesName": "ESTIMATE_SERIES", "issueDate": "2026-08-31", "client": { "name": "Client SRL", "vatCode": "RO22222222", "isTaxPayer": true, "address": "Str. Lalelei 1", "city": "Sector 1", "county": "Bucuresti", "country": "Romania", "email": "client@example.com" }, "products": [{ "name": "Produs 1", "code": "PRD001", "quantity": 1, "price": 100, "measuringUnitName": "buc", "taxPercentage": 21 }], "paymentUrl": "Generate URL" } ```
4. Issue a draft estimate Issues the estimate in draft state, without an assigned number. The document remains a draft until it is finalized manually in SmartBill Cloud. Set `isDraft: true`. ```json { "companyVatCode": "COMPANY_VAT_CODE", "isDraft": true, "seriesName": "ESTIMATE_SERIES", "issueDate": "2026-08-31", "client": { "name": "Client SRL", "vatCode": "RO22222222", "isTaxPayer": true, "address": "Str. Lalelei 1", "city": "Sector 1", "county": "Bucuresti", "country": "Romania", "email": "client@example.com" }, "products": [{ "name": "Produs 1", "code": "PRD001", "quantity": 1, "price": 100, "measuringUnitName": "buc", "taxPercentage": 21 }] } ```
5. Issue an estimate with discounts Discounts are added as separate lines with `isDiscount: true`. `numberOfItems` sets how many immediately preceding products the discount applies to. For a value discount, set `discountType: 1` and use `discountValue`. For a percentage discount, set `discountType: 2` and use `discountPercentage`; the percentage must be greater than 0. ```json { "companyVatCode": "COMPANY_VAT_CODE", "seriesName": "ESTIMATE_SERIES", "issueDate": "2026-08-31", "client": { "name": "Client SRL", "vatCode": "RO22222222", "isTaxPayer": true, "address": "Str. Lalelei 1", "city": "Sector 1", "county": "Bucuresti", "country": "Romania", "email": "client@example.com" }, "products": [ { "name": "Produs 1", "code": "PRD001", "quantity": 1, "price": 100, "measuringUnitName": "buc", "taxPercentage": 21 }, { "name": "Discount valoric", "isDiscount": true, "numberOfItems": 1, "discountType": 1, "discountValue": -10, "measuringUnitName": "buc", "taxPercentage": 21 }, { "name": "Produs 2", "code": "PRD002", "quantity": 1, "price": 200, "measuringUnitName": "buc", "taxPercentage": 21 }, { "name": "Discount procentual 10%", "isDiscount": true, "numberOfItems": 1, "discountType": 2, "discountPercentage": 10, "measuringUnitName": "buc", "taxPercentage": 21 } ] } ```
6. Issue an estimate with services Mark service-type products with `isService: true`. ```json { "companyVatCode": "COMPANY_VAT_CODE", "seriesName": "ESTIMATE_SERIES", "issueDate": "2026-08-31", "client": { "name": "Client SRL", "vatCode": "RO22222222", "isTaxPayer": true, "address": "Str. Lalelei 1", "city": "Sector 1", "county": "Bucuresti", "country": "Romania", "email": "client@example.com" }, "products": [{ "name": "Servicii consultanta", "code": "SRV001", "quantity": 1, "price": 100, "measuringUnitName": "ora", "taxPercentage": 21, "isService": true }] } ```
7. Issue an estimate with a due date Add `dueDate` to specify the estimate's due date. ```json { "companyVatCode": "COMPANY_VAT_CODE", "seriesName": "ESTIMATE_SERIES", "issueDate": "2026-08-31", "dueDate": "2026-09-30", "client": { "name": "Client SRL", "vatCode": "RO22222222", "isTaxPayer": true, "address": "Str. Lalelei 1", "city": "Sector 1", "county": "Bucuresti", "country": "Romania", "email": "client@example.com" }, "products": [{ "name": "Produs 1", "code": "PRD001", "quantity": 1, "price": 100, "measuringUnitName": "buc", "taxPercentage": 21 }] } ```
8. Issue an estimate and send it by email Issues the estimate and automatically emails it to the client. Set `sendEmail: true` and specify the address in `email.to`. The sender address and the template are configured from [Configurare > Email](https://cloud.smartbill.ro/core/configurare_mailuri/). ```json { "companyVatCode": "COMPANY_VAT_CODE", "seriesName": "ESTIMATE_SERIES", "issueDate": "2026-08-31", "sendEmail": true, "email": { "to": "client@example.com", "cc": "", "bcc": "" }, "client": { "name": "Client SRL", "vatCode": "RO22222222", "isTaxPayer": true, "address": "Str. Lalelei 1", "city": "Sector 1", "county": "Bucuresti", "country": "Romania", "email": "client@example.com" }, "products": [{ "name": "Produs 1", "code": "PRD001", "quantity": 1, "price": 100, "measuringUnitName": "buc", "taxPercentage": 21 }] } ```
9. Issue an estimate in foreign currency Issues the estimate in foreign currency. Set `currency` and `exchangeRate` at the estimate level, and `currency` on each product with the same currency - the exchange rate appears on the estimate alongside the RON equivalent. `exchangeRate` is optional; if not specified, the rate from [Preferinte personale](https://cloud.smartbill.ro/core/configurare/preferinte-personale/) is used (the "Curs valutar preluat de pe Internet" section: today's or yesterday's rate, with an optional percentage markup). ```json { "companyVatCode": "COMPANY_VAT_CODE", "seriesName": "ESTIMATE_SERIES", "issueDate": "2026-08-31", "currency": "EUR", "exchangeRate": 4.97, "client": { "name": "Client SRL", "vatCode": "RO22222222", "isTaxPayer": true, "address": "Str. Lalelei 1", "city": "Sector 1", "county": "Bucuresti", "country": "Romania", "email": "client@example.com" }, "products": [ { "name": "Produs 1", "code": "PRD001", "quantity": 1, "price": 100, "measuringUnitName": "buc", "taxPercentage": 21, "currency": "EUR" } ] } ```
10. Issue an estimate with a reference price in foreign currency Useful when contracts are in foreign currency but you issue the estimate in RON - for example, a maintenance subscription of 100 EUR issued at the daily rate. Requires enabling the "Am preturi cu moneda de referinta in valuta" option in [Configurare > Generale](https://cloud.smartbill.ro/documente/preferinte-generale/) in SmartBill Cloud. Set `currency` at the product level to the contract currency and `currency` at the estimate level to the issuing currency. `exchangeRate` on the product is optional; if not specified, the rate from [Preferinte personale](https://cloud.smartbill.ro/core/configurare/preferinte-personale/) is used (the "Curs valutar preluat de pe Internet" section: today's or yesterday's rate, with an optional percentage markup). ```json { "companyVatCode": "COMPANY_VAT_CODE", "seriesName": "ESTIMATE_SERIES", "issueDate": "2026-08-31", "currency": "RON", "client": { "name": "Client SRL", "vatCode": "RO22222222", "isTaxPayer": true, "address": "Str. Lalelei 1", "city": "Sector 1", "county": "Bucuresti", "country": "Romania", "email": "client@example.com" }, "products": [ { "name": "Produs 1", "code": "PRD001", "quantity": 1, "price": 497, "measuringUnitName": "buc", "taxPercentage": 21, "currency": "EUR", "exchangeRate": 4.97 } ] } ```
11. Issue an estimate with an intra-community VAT code If you are registered in the One Stop Shop electronic system, go to your SmartBill account at [Configurare > Date Firma](https://cloud.smartbill.ro/core/configurare/date-firma/) and fill in the `CIF intracomunitar` field. If you need an OSS CIF, use the `Genereaza CIF OSS` option shown next to the field. Once configured, set `useIntraCif: true` to issue the estimate with this CIF. ```json { "companyVatCode": "COMPANY_VAT_CODE", "useIntraCif": true, "seriesName": "ESTIMATE_SERIES", "issueDate": "2026-08-31", "client": { "name": "Company GmbH", "vatCode": "DE123456789", "address": "Musterstrasse 1", "city": "Berlin", "county": "Berlin", "country": "Germania" }, "products": [{ "name": "Servicii consultanta", "code": "SRV001", "quantity": 1, "price": 100, "measuringUnitName": "buc", "taxPercentage": 0, "taxName": "Taxare inversa", "isService": true }] } ```
12. Issue an estimate - non-VAT-paying issuer If your company is not a VAT payer, you do not need to fill in the VAT-related fields on products. ```json { "companyVatCode": "COMPANY_VAT_CODE", "seriesName": "ESTIMATE_SERIES", "issueDate": "2026-08-31", "client": { "name": "Client SRL", "vatCode": "RO22222222", "isTaxPayer": true, "address": "Str. Lalelei 1", "city": "Sector 1", "county": "Bucuresti", "country": "Romania", "email": "client@example.com" }, "products": [{ "name": "Produs 1", "code": "PRD001", "quantity": 1, "price": 100, "measuringUnitName": "buc" }] } ```
13. Issue an estimate with different VAT rates Add products with different VAT rates as separate lines with the corresponding `taxPercentage` - SmartBill automatically groups them by rate on the document. At the 0% rate, always specify a `taxName` that exists in the account, for example `Taxare inversa`, `TVA Inclus`, `SDD` or `SFDD`; without it, the API defaults to `Taxare inversa`, regardless of the correct tax regime. ```json { "companyVatCode": "COMPANY_VAT_CODE", "seriesName": "ESTIMATE_SERIES", "issueDate": "2026-08-31", "client": { "name": "Client SRL", "vatCode": "RO22222222", "isTaxPayer": true, "address": "Str. 14. Issue an estimate in a foreign language The estimate is issued in Romanian (`RO`) by default. To issue it in another language, set the `language` parameter at estimate level. You can use a language predefined in SmartBill Cloud or a language defined by the administrator in the Cloud account. The value sent in `language` must match a language available in the account. `language` controls the document language, but product names and measuring units must be translated explicitly on each product, using `translatedName` and `translatedMeasuringUnit`. ```json { "companyVatCode": "COMPANY_VAT_CODE", "seriesName": "ESTIMATE_SERIES", "issueDate": "2026-08-31", "language": "EN", "client": { "name": "Client SRL", "vatCode": "RO22222222", "isTaxPayer": true, "address": "Str. Issue an estimate with observations and mentions Use `observations` and `mentions` for the texts displayed on the estimate. ```json { "companyVatCode": "COMPANY_VAT_CODE", "seriesName": "ESTIMATE_SERIES", "issueDate": "2026-08-31", "client": { "name": "Client SRL", "vatCode": "RO22222222", "isTaxPayer": true, "address": "Str. Downloads the estimate as a PDF. Parameters are sent in the URL (query string). The estimate can be retrieved through the API only as a PDF file. There is no endpoint for retrieving an estimate as JSON or XML. The successful response is a binary file (`application/octet-stream`), sent with `Content-Disposition: attachment`. The filename starts with `factura` even for estimates - for example `facturapro0271.pdf`. The response `Content-Type` mirrors the `Accept` header sent in the request: if you ask for `Accept: application/json`, the response is labelled `application/json`, even though the body is the same PDF. Do not rely on `Content-Type` to decide how to handle the response. **Do not send `Accept: application/pdf`.** The most natural value is the only one that fails: the response is `406` with `{"code": "invalid_accept_header"}`, not the PDF. What works is `application/octet-stream`, `*/*`, `application/json`, or omitting the `Accept` header entirely. **Got an error while downloading?** **Authentication and authorization errors are common to all V1 endpoints.** For email/token, `cif`, rights on the company or on the series, see [API V1 Errors](#api-1/description/api-v1-errors). Checks whether an estimate was converted into an invoice. Parameters are sent in the URL (query string). The response contains: - `areInvoicesCreated` - `true` if the estimate has been invoiced, otherwise `false`. - `invoices` - the list of invoices generated from the estimate (`series`, `number`), present when `areInvoicesCreated` is `true`. **Draft invoices appear in the list as well, with an empty `number`.** An invoice saved as a draft does not have a number yet, so its entry looks like `{"series": "API", "number": ""}`, and `areInvoicesCreated` becomes `true` even when the only invoice generated from the estimate is a draft.
