post.description:
Issues a payment. The payment type (`type`) determines which fields are required and whether a numbered document is generated. `Chitanta` and `Bon` generate numbered documents - the receipt on the series sent in `seriesName`, the fiscal receipt on the configured cash register. The other types (`Card`, `Ordin plata` etc.) issue the payment without a separate document. ## Issuing a fiscal receipt For a fiscal receipt, send `type: Bon`. Before the first call, a default cash register must be configured in the Cloud account, under **Configurari > Case de marcat** - receipts are issued on it. The setup is per user: the cash register must be configured for the user you authenticate with. There are two ways to print the receipt, selected through the `returnFiscalPrinterText` field: **1. Printing from the SmartBill account** - `returnFiscalPrinterText: false` (default) The receipt is inserted into SmartBill through the API and printed from the SmartBill account. The `message` field in the response comes back empty. Recommended when the cash register is in a different physical location. **2. Printing directly on the cash register** - `returnFiscalPrinterText: true` The response contains the `message` field with the receipt content, Base64 encoded. The content must be decoded and written to a file with the name and extension configured for the cash register (`bon.inp` by default). When a fiscal receipt is issued, the response contains `id` (the unique identifier of the receipt, which you can later use to retrieve the content through `GET /payment/text`), `number` (which comes back as `0` when issued through the API - the number is allocated on the cash register, at print time) and, in the second case, `message`. The payment method breakdown is provided through the `receivedCash`, `receivedCard`, `receivedTicheteMasa` and the other `received*` fields. A fiscal receipt is issued in lei only: `currency` must be `RON` (the default value). On receipt lines, send only `taxPercentage` and **omit `taxName`**. An account can have several rates with the same percentage, and if the one sent in `taxName` is not configured on the cash register, the call is rejected. Without `taxName`, the server picks a rate that is configured on the register. The default cash register belongs to the **user**, not to the company: the receipt is issued on the default cash register of the user making the API call, even if another user of the same company has a different register set as default. VAT rates and payment methods are configured separately on each cash register, and a receipt that uses a rate not configured on that register is rejected. ## Discount on a fiscal receipt Discounts on a receipt are added as separate lines with `isDiscount: true`. To avoid certain limitations of cash registers (or blocking them), a discount that covers several products is split into smaller discounts, one for each product. For example: for a receipt with 3 products and one total discount for them, the discount is split into 3 parts, so the receipt will have 6 lines. The discount can be a percentage (`discountPercentage`) or a value (`discountValue`). For a value discount, `discountValue` is sent as a negative number and is subtracted from the receipt total as a tax-inclusive amount. The discount line follows the same price rule as the product lines: with `isTaxIncluded: true` the amounts include VAT, with `false` they do not. See the **Fiscal receipt with a value discount** example in the request example list. **Got an error while issuing the payment?** **Authentication and authorization errors are common to all V1 endpoints.** For email/token, `companyVatCode`, company or series rights, see [API V1 Errors](#api-1/description/api-v1-errors). Below you will find only the errors specific to payments.
Errors when issuing the payment
Situation Error Suggestion
Client details missing Datele clientului trebuie specificate. Ele se preiau din factura doar in cazul in care usePaymentDetails = true. Send the `client` object (name + VAT code), or `useInvoiceDetails: true` to take the client from the invoice.
Payment value missing Valoarea incasarii trebuie specificata. Send `value` with the collected amount, or `useInvoiceDetails: true` to take it from the invoice.
Payment type missing Tipul incasarii trebuie specificat. Send `type`, for example `Chitanta`, `Card` or `Ordin plata`.
Client VAT code differs from the invoice (payment linked to an invoice) Ciful clientului de pe factura fac3802 difera de ciful clientului incasarii! For a payment linked to an invoice, the client must have the same VAT code as the invoice client. Use `useInvoiceDetails: true` to avoid the mismatch.
Invalid payment type Tipul documentului nu a fost gasit pe server! Use a valid `type`: `Chitanta`, `Bon`, `Card`, `Card online`, `Ordin plata`, `Cec`, `Bilet ordin`, `Mandat postal`, `Extras de cont`, `Ramburs` or `Alta incasare`. Casing does not matter (`Cec`, `CEC` and `cec` all work), but extra spaces invalidate the value.
Receipt series does not exist in the account Seria nu a fost gasita! Folositi o serie creata in contul de cloud. Send a receipt series that exists in the SmartBill Cloud account in `seriesName`.
Invoice in invoicesList not found Factura nu a fost gasita! Check `seriesName` and `number` in `invoicesList` - the invoice must exist in the account.
The invoice in invoicesList is cancelled Factura API0059 este anulata, nu o puteti incasa. Restaurati intai factura sau emiteti incasarea independent de factura. Restore the invoice with [PUT /invoice/restore](#tag/invoices/PUT/invoice/restore), or issue the payment without `invoicesList`, sending `client` and `value`.
The invoice is already paid in full or reversed Factura este incasata sau stornata in totalitate. Check first with [GET /invoice/paymentstatus](#tag/invoices/GET/invoice/paymentstatus) how much is still outstanding. An invoice with `unpaidAmount` of zero accepts no further payments.
Fiscal receipt for a company not registered for VAT, without the matching cash register setup Configurarea casei de marcat pentru firma neplatitoare de TVA nu a fost facuta. In the SmartBill Cloud account, under `Configurari > Case de marcat`, check that the payment methods have their cash register IDs saved, that the VAT rate IDs are filled in under `Configurari > Cote TVA`, and that you authenticate with the user the cash register is configured for - the setup is per user.
No cash register configured for the calling user Nu s-a gasit casa de marcat pentru userul x. Configure a cash register in the SmartBill Cloud account, under `Configurari > Case de marcat`, for the user you authenticate with.
The VAT rate used on the receipt lines is not configured on the user's default cash register VAT rate Normala (21.00%) nu a fost configurata pentru casa de marcat selectata The simplest fix: omit `taxName` and send only `taxPercentage` - the server then picks a rate that is configured on the register. Otherwise, configure the rate you send in `taxName` on the cash register, in the SmartBill Cloud account under `Configurari > Case de marcat`. Rates are configured separately on each register, and the default register differs from one user to another.
Fiscal receipt issued in a currency other than lei Bonurile fiscale pot fi emise doar in Lei! Send `currency: RON`, or omit the field - `RON` is the default value.
Fiscal receipt with payment methods that are not configured on the cash register Au fost inregistrate urmatoarele plati partiale cu metode de plata neconfigurate pe casa de marcat: Card: 10, Numerar: 5 Check the cash register setup in the SmartBill Cloud account - every method used in the `received*` fields must be configured on the cash register.
- -- ## Payment types
1. Card Issues a card payment. Does not require a series and does not generate a separate document. ```json { "companyVatCode": "COMPANY_VAT_CODE", "issueDate": "2026-08-31", "client": { "name": "Client SRL", "vatCode": "RO22222222", "address": "Str. Lalelei 1", "city": "Sector 1", "county": "Bucuresti", "country": "Romania" }, "value": 119, "type": "Card" } ```
2. Receipt Generates a receipt document with a number from the specified series. Requires `seriesName` and `isCash: true`. ```json { "companyVatCode": "COMPANY_VAT_CODE", "seriesName": "RECEIPT_SERIES", "issueDate": "2026-08-31", "client": { "name": "Client SRL", "vatCode": "RO22222222", "address": "Str. Lalelei 1", "city": "Sector 1", "county": "Bucuresti", "country": "Romania" }, "value": 119, "text": "Plata factura", "type": "Chitanta", "isCash": true } ```
3. Draft receipt Saves the receipt as a draft - without an assigned number until it is finalized from the SmartBill Cloud interface. Works only for the `Chitanta` type. ```json { "companyVatCode": "COMPANY_VAT_CODE", "seriesName": "RECEIPT_SERIES", "issueDate": "2026-08-31", "isDraft": true, "client": { "name": "Client SRL", "vatCode": "RO22222222", "address": "Str. Lalelei 1", "city": "Sector 1", "county": "Bucuresti", "country": "Romania" }, "value": 119, "text": "Plata factura", "type": "Chitanta", "isCash": true } ```
4. Fiscal receipt Issues a receipt on the cash register configured as default in the Cloud account (**Configurari > Case de marcat**). Requires `type: Bon` and the product lines in `products`. The `returnFiscalPrinterText` field selects the printing mode: - `false` (default) - the receipt is printed from the SmartBill account, and the `message` field in the response comes back empty. Recommended when the cash register is in a different physical location. - `true` - the response contains `message`, the receipt content Base64 encoded. It must be decoded and written to a file with the name and extension configured for the cash register (`bon.inp` by default). The payment method breakdown is provided through the `received*` fields. The receipt is issued in lei only: `currency` must be `RON` (the default value). ```json { "companyVatCode": "COMPANY_VAT_CODE", "issueDate": "2026-08-31", "client": { "name": "Client SRL", "vatCode": "RO22222222", "address": "Str. Lalelei 1", "city": "Sector 1", "county": "Bucuresti", "country": "Romania" }, "products": [ { "name": "Produs 1", "code": "PRD001", "quantity": 1, "measuringUnitName": "buc", "taxPercentage": 21, "price": 10 } ], "value": 10, "type": "Bon", "returnFiscalPrinterText": true, "receivedCash": 10 } ``` The response contains `id` (used later with `GET /payment/text`), `number` and, when `returnFiscalPrinterText` is `true`, `message`.
5. Payment order Issues a payment by payment order. Does not require a series and does not generate a separate document. ```json { "companyVatCode": "COMPANY_VAT_CODE", "issueDate": "2026-08-31", "client": { "name": "Client SRL", "vatCode": "RO22222222", "address": "Str. Lalelei 1", "city": "Sector 1", "county": "Bucuresti", "country": "Romania" }, "value": 119, "text": "Plata factura", "type": "Ordin plata" } ```
6. Payment linked to an invoice Associates the payment with one or more existing invoices via `invoicesList`. ```json { "companyVatCode": "COMPANY_VAT_CODE", "seriesName": "RECEIPT_SERIES", "issueDate": "2026-08-31", "client": { "name": "Client SRL", "vatCode": "RO22222222", "address": "Str. Lalelei 1", "city": "Sector 1", "county": "Bucuresti", "country": "Romania" }, "value": 119, "type": "Chitanta", "isCash": true, "invoicesList": [{ "seriesName": "INVOICE_SERIES", "number": "0025" }] } ```
7. Payment with data taken from the invoice With `useInvoiceDetails: true`, the client and the amount are taken automatically from the invoice - you no longer need to send them explicitly. Two things to know: - **`value` is not ignored if you send it anyway.** On an invoice of 111 RON, a payment with `value: 50` records 50 and leaves 61 outstanding. That is how you make a partial payment. - **`invoicesList` accepts several invoices.** A single call records the payment against every invoice in the list. A **cancelled** invoice cannot be paid: the call returns `400` with `Factura este anulata, nu o puteti incasa. Restaurati intai factura sau emiteti incasarea independent de factura.`. An invoice already paid in full returns `400` with `Factura este incasata sau stornata in totalitate.`. ```json { "companyVatCode": "COMPANY_VAT_CODE", "issueDate": "2026-08-31", "type": "Ordin plata", "useInvoiceDetails": true, "invoicesList": [{ "seriesName": "INVOICE_SERIES", "number": "0025" }] } ```

post.description:
Sends an invoice or estimate to the client via email as an attachment. **Requirements**: You must configure your email server in [SmartBill Cloud > Configurare > Email](https://cloud.smartbill.ro/core/configurare_mailuri/). **Email Template Variables:** The `bodyText` parameter supports these placeholders: - `#tip document#` - Document type (factura/estimate) - `#serie numar document#` - Series and number - `#link document#` - URL to document - `#data emiterii#` - Issue date - `#data scadentei#` - Due date - `#total document#` - Total amount with currency - `#mentiune#` - Document notes - `#nume client#` - Client name - `#persoana contact#` - Contact person **Note**: Both `subject` and `bodyText` must be Base64 encoded. ## What is required and what falls back Only `companyVatCode`, `seriesName`, `number` and `type` are required. The rest have fallbacks: - `to` missing or empty - the email is sent to the client address on the document; - `subject` or `bodyText` missing - the template configured in the SmartBill account is used. The value in `type` is not case-sensitive: `factura`, `Factura` and `FACTURA` are all accepted. `type` also selects which document family is searched - an estimate sent with `type: factura` returns `Documentul nu a fost gasit`. ## Response shape This endpoint does not respond like the rest of V1. The response carries a `status` object, with `code` and `message`: ```json { "status": { "code": 0, "message": "Documentul a fost trimis cu succes." } } ``` `code` is `0` on success and `1` on error. There is no `errorText` field - a client checking only `errorText` never sees the error. The exception: authentication and company-access errors come back in the classic V1 shape, with `errorText`, and with HTTP status `401`. **Got an error while sending the email?** **Authentication and authorization errors are common to all V1 endpoints.** For email/token, `companyVatCode`, company rights, see [API V1 Errors](#api-1/description/api-v1-errors). Below you will find only the errors specific to this endpoint. All of them come with `status.code: 1`.

Situation Error Suggestion
Unsupported value in type Valoarea campului 'type' nu este suportata (invoice). Valorile acceptate sunt: factura, proforma. Send `factura` or `proforma`. The English variants `invoice` and `estimate` are not accepted. Casing does not matter.
type missing or empty type trebuie specificat. Valorile acceptate sunt: factura, proforma. `type` is required, unlike `to`, `subject` and `bodyText`.
The document does not exist, or type does not match its kind Documentul nu a fost gasit Check `seriesName` and `number`. It also appears when the document exists but is sent with the wrong type - an estimate with `type: factura`, for example.

useStock.description: Discharges stock when the invoice is issued. Product lines must include the matching warehouse. How the product is identified depends on the `Foloseste cod produs` setting in the account. When it is enabled, the product is identified **by `code` only**: one that exists in stock is not found by name, and the call returns `Produsul ... nu are codul specificat.`. When it is disabled, the product is identified **by name**, case-insensitively. In both cases the catalogue name is overwritten with the one you send, even when `saveToDb` is `false` - sending `mere - 76` for the product `Mere - 76` renames it. The unit of measure must be exactly the one on the catalogue product, and `buc` and `BUC` are treated as different.

useInvoiceDetails.description: Takes the client and the amount from the indicated invoice. A `value` sent explicitly takes precedence and allows a partial payment.

saveToDb.description: Saves the client to the catalogue if new. Defaults to `false`, so the client is not saved unless you ask for it - not even with stock discharge.

code.description: Product code (SKU). **Required if your company has the "Foloseste cod produs" setting enabled** in SmartBill Cloud, otherwise optional.

isService.description: Whether this line is a service, not a physical product

quantity.description: Quantity. The API does not validate it: `0` and negative values are accepted and the document is issued without an error. Validate the quantity in your integration before sending.

isTaxIncluded.description: Whether the price includes VAT. Defaults to `false`, so prices are treated as excluding VAT.

taxPercentage.description: VAT percentage rate. SmartBill accepts the VAT rates available in the account, including custom rates.

isDiscount.description: Whether this line is a discount line

numberOfItems.description: Number of **immediately preceding** lines the discount applies to. **Required on a discount line**: without it the discount is silently ignored, the call returns `200`, and the document is issued with the total unreduced.

discountType.description:
Discount type. `1` = value discount, with the amount in `discountValue`. `2` = percentage discount, with the percentage in `discountPercentage`. Defaults to `2`: a discount line without `discountType`, but with both values sent, applies the percentage.

**Send only `1` or `2`.** Any other value is not rejected, but it produces an incorrect document: a value discount is subtracted from the total without adjusting VAT, and a percentage discount is ignored entirely. For a 100 RON product with 21% VAT and a 10 RON discount, `discountType: 1` gives 108.9, while a value outside the enumeration gives 111.

discountValue.description: Discount value, for value discounts, when `discountType` is `1`. **It must be negative**, so send it with a minus sign: `-10` for a 10 RON discount. A positive value is not rejected, but it **increases** the total instead of reducing it - a 100 RON product with `discountValue: 10` gives 133.1, not 108.9.

discountPercentage.description: Discount percentage. Used for percentage discounts, when `discountType` is `2`. The value must be greater than 0 and at most 100.

saveToDb.description: Saves the product to the catalogue if it is new. When the product already exists and is sent with `saveToDb: true`, its catalogue record is updated from the request - including the name. With stock discharge (`useStock: true`) the update happens regardless, even with `saveToDb: false`.

useSBProductName.description: Controls which name appears on the invoice when the product is matched by `code` and the name sent in `name` differs from the one in the nomenclature. `true` = the invoice uses the product name from SmartBill and the nomenclature name is NOT changed. `false` or omitted = the invoice uses the name sent in `name`, which overwrites the product name in the nomenclature (even when `saveToDb` is `false`). Requires the "Foloseste cod produs" setting enabled for the company.
